import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

I = range(1, 9)

m.setParam("OutputFlag", 0)

x = {i: m.addVar(vtype=GRB.BINARY, name=f"x{i}") for i in I}

m.setObjective(gp.quicksum(v[i] * x[i] for i in I), GRB.MAXIMIZE)

m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(b[i] * x[i] for i in I) <= 100, "budget")
m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(h[i] * x[i] for i in I) <= 18, "personale")
m.addConstr(x[5] <= x[2], "P5_richiede_P2")
m.addConstr(x[7] <= x[3], "P7_richiede_P3")
m.addConstr(x[4] + x[6] <= 1, "P4_P6_incompatibili")
m.addConstr(x[1] + x[3] + x[7] >= 1, "almeno_un_digitale")
m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(x[i] for i in I) >= 3, "almeno_tre_progetti")

start = {1: 1, 2: 1, 3: 1, 6: 1, 8: 1}
for i in I:

    GRB.INFEASIBLE: "INFEASIBLE",
    GRB.INF_OR_UNBD: "INF_OR_UNBD",
    GRB.UNBOUNDED: "UNBOUNDED",
}
status_label = status_map.get(m.Status, f"STATUS_{m.Status}")

    variables = {f"x{i}": float(round(x[i].X, 6)) for i in I}
    result = {"status": "OPTIMAL", "objective": float(m.ObjVal), "variables": variables}
else:
    result = {"status": status_label, "objective": None, "variables": {}}

print("SOLUTION_JSON=" + json.dumps(result, separators=(",", ":")))
